card.name: Digits inside long decimal numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit number, usually after a decimal point. Seen in dose tables, concentrations, filter pore sizes and long numeric strings.

modes.label: Decimals in dose and concentration
modes.description: A digit within a decimal value, often followed by units like mcg, mg/mL or micrometer.
modes.example: 0625 mg/mL At least 2 mL 1.484 mcg 0.25 mg/mL 5.9<<3>>8 mcg 1 mg/mL

modes.label: Long numeric strings
modes.description: A digit inside a very long number or ID, with no units involved.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a number, such as one inside a decimal dose or a long figure.
